---
title: CutCap overview
description: What CutCap does and how the caption editing workflow fits together inside Premiere Pro.
---

**CutCap** is a caption editor that lives inside Adobe Premiere Pro. Cleaning up captions is the worst part of the edit — auto-generated SRTs come out with lines broken in the wrong places, words that need fixing, and timing you can only check by scrubbing back and forth. Premiere's built-in caption workflow makes every small fix a chore.

CutCap fixes that. Import any **SRT, VTT, or CSV**, refine the cut and the wording right in the panel, and push the finished captions back onto your timeline — as a caption track or as Motion Graphics Template clips — without ever leaving Premiere.

:::note[CutCap does not transcribe]
CutCap **edits caption files you already have** — from Premiere's speech-to-text, a transcription service, or anywhere else that gives you an SRT. It doesn't generate captions from audio; it makes fixing them fast.
:::

## The workflow

1. **[Import](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/importing/)** an SRT, VTT, or CSV — from a file, a whole folder, or dragged straight from Premiere's Project panel.
2. **[Edit](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/editing/)** word-by-word: fix wording, split and merge lines, add and delete captions.
3. **[Clean up](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/cleanup/)** the whole file in one pass — gaps, line breaks, punctuation.
4. **[Review & search](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/review-and-search/)** with flags, notes, and Find & Replace.
5. **[Export or push](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/output/)** back to Premiere as a caption track, or **[as MOGRTs](/toolninja-docs/cutcap/mogrts/)**.

Work is **auto-saved continuously** — close the panel mid-edit and pick up exactly where you left off.

## Requirements

- **Windows** only in v1.
- **Premiere Pro 2023–2026** (CEP panel, v23.0+). Tested on Premiere Pro 2026.
